snippet.title: Better Than Dead | Launch Trailer | Out Now in Early Access on Steam
snippet.description:
Better Than Dead is out now in Early Access on Steam.

🔻 Get it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2599690/Better_Than_Dead/

A brutal bodycam FPS set in the depths of Hong Kong. Armed with a pistol and a kill list, fight through neon-lit corridors, cramped apartments, seedy clubs, and rooftop hideouts in a revenge-driven assault inspired by classic Hong Kong action cinema.

Fast. Lethal. Unforgiving. Every encounter is decided in seconds.
#BetterThanDead #MicroProse #FPS #SteamEarlyAccess
